name: Cursemute
description: A wave of Avacyn's spells that transformed many werewolves and curses.

description_citations.text: "Innistrad (plane)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn offers the Gatstaf werewolves a place at her side and transforms them into wolfir in the Cursemute.
timeline.quote: she transformed them into the wolfir

citation.text: "Avacyn", section "The Cursemute". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn transforms the Gatstaf werewolves into wolfir and her cursemute spreads through the plane.
timeline.quote: she transformed them into the wolfir

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "The Cursemute". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn casts the Cursemute at Gatstaf Grotto, creating the Wolfir.
timeline.quote: where Avacyn cast the Cursemute , creating the Wolfir .

citation.text: "Kessig", section "Locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Krallenhorde survives the Cursemute intact.
timeline.quote: The Krallenhorde survived the Cursemute intact.

citation.text: "Werewolf", section "The Krallenhorde". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After being released from the Helvault, Avacyn casts the cursemute, letting werewolves choose to fuse their human and wolf spirits into a permanent wolf form.
timeline.quote: After Avacyn was released from the Helvault , she cast a spell that granted the werewolves a choice to either remain a werewolf

citation.text: "Wolf", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The cursemute also stifles Garruk's curse for a while.
timeline.quote: This spell is called the cursemute , and also stifled Garruk 's curse for a while.

citation.text: "Wolf", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: She rid the land of the lycanthrope curse.
relations.quote: Every morning since the Cursemute had rid the land of the lycanthrope curse

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.
